raised: Unclear whether 'retirement age: 3 years is enough' applies to someone joining at 61 (3 years from joining, or only after retiring)
The page never says the tax rate for people over 60; it only gives the 'under 60, at least 31%' rate
Salary is over the 15,712 limit: unclear whether deposits on the full salary are tax-free, and why the striped tax part is still in the chart at year 12 after the exemption
The '123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנתה' row at the top is confusing
The menu bar cuts across the page in the middle of reading
Can't judge the default return (7) and management fee (0.54) in the calculator
The S&P500 line under the chart means little to the reader
The '47% tax at source, assumes you file an annual report' note is worrying: do I have to file a report myself? What is the final tax?
The 2% maximum fee in the fees table clashes with the 0.54% in the calculator; unclear which one applies
The three tax cards run half off the screen behind small arrows, which is annoying
The chief economist line is worrying: will the benefit be cut?
The part about seniority (ותק) restarting when withdrawing is too complicated to understand
The dark brown and dark grey blocks in the big chart are not understood
The colour layers in the small 1–12 bars are too small to read
The 'חוקים וכללים · N' tags are everywhere and it's unclear what clicking one does
Why the tax is 64,761 when the under-60 rate doesn't apply
No plain comparison of joining against not joining: is the 2,250 paid as salary instead, or lost?
No 6-year result in numbers; the chart starts at the 5-year worst case
No figure for how 750 a month affects take-home pay after tax
Nothing on what happens if you stop working before 6 years
Would drop the company cards and 'הצגת החברות'
Would drop most of the terms table
Would drop 'הכי קרוב לזה' and the 'כדאי להכיר גם' buttons
Would drop the S&P500 / 19-tracks lines

problems.why: The reader asks why the striped tax part is still in the chart at year 12 after the exemption, ties it to the salary being over the 15,712 limit, and is unsure which part of the deposit is taxed — this is the person's complaint that tax still shows after 6 years with a high salary.
